    // Basic Functions
    function replaceSpace(str) {
        return str.toString().replace(/[ )(%~]/g, '_');
    };

    function calBorder (dataObj, mask, func) {
        var tmpArr = [];
        for (var k in dataObj){
            if (mask[k] == true) {
                tmpArr.push(func(dataObj[k]));
            };
        };
        return func(tmpArr);
    };

    function deepCopy (obj) {
        if (obj instanceof Array) {
            var newObj = [];
        }else{
            var newObj = {};
        };
        for (var k in obj){
            newObj[k] = typeof obj[k] === 'object' ? deepCopy(obj[k]) : obj[k];
        };
        return newObj;
    };

    function zipIdx (obj, idx, mask){
        var newArr = [];
        for (var k in obj){
            if (mask[k] == true) {
                newArr.push(obj[k][idx]);
            };
        };
        return newArr;
    };

    function getTextWidth (obj, fontSize, mainText) {
        var t = obj.append('text')
                   .style('font-size', fontSize + 'px')
                   .style('opacity', 0)
                   .text(mainText);
        var textWidth = t.node().getBBox().width;
        t.remove();
        return textWidth;
    };

    function realignBySeries (obj, seriesList, changedSeries) {
		//seriesList.length = 0;
		changedSeries.length = 0;
        if (seriesList.length == 0) {
            for (var k in obj) {
                changedSeries.push(k);
            };
            return obj;
        };
        var newObj = {};
        for (var k in seriesList){
            if (seriesList[k] in obj) {
                newObj[seriesList[k]] = obj[seriesList[k]];
                changedSeries.push(seriesList[k]);
            };
        };
        if ("xTag" in obj) {
            newObj["xTag"] = obj["xTag"];
        };
        return newObj;
    };

	function selectFirst30Samples(obj){
		
		var objKeys = d3.keys(obj);
		var keyLen = objKeys.length;
		var dataLen = obj[objKeys[0]].length;
		var tempLists = [];
		var tempKeys = ["key1", "key2", "key3"];
		for(var i = 0; i < dataLen; i++){
			var tempObj = {}
			for(var j = 0; j < keyLen; j++){
				tempObj[tempKeys[j]] = obj[objKeys[j]][i];
			}
			tempLists.push(tempObj);
		}
		
		tempLists.sort(function(a, b){ return b.key2 - a.key2});
		
		var newObj = {}
		var selectedLen = dataLen;
		if(selectedLen > 30)
			selectedLen = 30;
		//selectedLen = 4;
		for(var i = 0; i < keyLen; i++){
			var tempList = [];
			for(var j = 0; j < selectedLen; j++)
				tempList.push(tempLists[j][tempKeys[i]])
			newObj[objKeys[i]] = tempList;
		}
		
		return newObj;
	}
	
    function compare (method, value, target) {
        // compare value and target by given symbol(">" or "<")
        if (method == ">") {
            return value > target;
        }else if (method == "<"){
            return value < target;
        }else{
            console.log("Symbol Error: " + [value, method, target].join(" "));
            // Not the best soluation for wrong cutoff
            return true;
        };
    }

        var f = this;


		this.initt = function(dataObj){
			this.dataObj = realignBySeries(dataObj, opt.series, this.series);
			this.redraw(0);

		}

        this.init = function (){
			this.dataObj = realignBySeries(this.dataObj, opt.series, this.series);

			this.datasetLen = dataObj[d3.keys(dataObj)[0]].length;

				
            // Show all lines in default
            for (var k in this.dataObj){
                this.drawLine[k] = true;
            };

            // Draw title
            this.title = this.div.append('p')
                             .attr('class', 'svgTitle')
                             .style('text-align', 'center')
                             .append('a')

                                 for (var i = 0; i < f.datasetLen ; i++) {

							   if(testBrowser() != "IE") {

                            .text(opt.yTitle)

                         .attr('class', 'tipLine')

                         .attr('y1', opt.paddingTop)
                         .attr('x2', 0)
                         .attr('y2', opt.paddingTop + this.yAxisLen)

            this.tipSelector = this.svg.append('rect')

                    var p = this.currentDataObj[name][idx];
                    return Math.round(100*(p.top - p.bot))/100;
                }
            };

            // draw static X axis
            if ("xTag" in this.dataObj) {
                this.xTag = this.dataObj["xTag"];
                delete this.dataObj["xTag"];

                for (var i = 0; i < this.datasetLen; i++) {

            var legendY = 1;

            for (var s in this.series){
                var seriesW = getTextWidth(this.svg, opt.lengendFont, this.series[s]) + squareWidth + lengendSpace;

                    legendY += squareWidth + 10;
                    legendStart = s;
                }else {
                    for (var j = legendStart; j < textW.length; j++) {
                        textW[j][0] -= seriesW;
                    };
                };
                textW.push([(opt.width - opt.paddingRight - seriesW), legendY]);
            };
            var lengendX = opt.width - opt.paddingRight - textW.length*(squareWidth + lengendSpace) - d3.sum(textW);
            var lengendGroup = this.svg.append('g').attr('id', 'lengend');

                                            f.lineObj[l].style('opacity', .2);

                                    };

                                   f.drawLine[f.series[d]] = true;

                               };

                lengendGroup.append('text')

            };

        this.redraw = function(delay){
            this.drawAxis(delay);

            if (opt.type == "line") {
                this.drawLine(delay);
            }else if(opt.type == "area"){
                this.drawArea(delay);
            };
        };

        this.drawAxis = function(delay){
            if (opt.type == "line") {
                // Calculate max/min value
                var yMax = calBorder(this.dataObj, this.drawLine, d3.max);
                var yMin = calBorder(this.dataObj, this.drawLine, d3.min);

                // Add scale factor for max and min value
                yMin = yMin > 0 ? yMin * opt.minFactor : yMin * opt.maxFactor;
                yMax = yMax > 0 ? yMax * opt.maxFactor : yMax * opt.minFactor;
            } else if(opt.type == "area"){
                var yMax = 100;
                var yMin = 0;
            };

            this.yScale = d3.scale.linear()
                            .domain([yMin, yMax])
                            .range([opt.paddingTop + this.yAxisLen, opt.paddingTop]);

            var yInner = d3.svg.axis()
                           .scale(this.yScale)
                           .tickSize(6, 10, 3)
                           .orient("left");

            // Inner Line
            if (opt.innerLine) {
                yInner.tickSize(-this.xAxisLen, 10, 3);
            };

            if (this.yAxis === null) {
                this.yAxis = this.svg.append("g")
                           .attr("class","y axis")
                           .attr("transform", "translate("+ opt.paddingLeft +",0)")
                           .call(yInner);
            }else if(yMax){
                this.yAxis.transition().duration(delay).call(yInner);
            };
            // Move yTitle to a proper distance from Y axis
            var newYTitleX = opt.paddingTop + this.yAxisLen/2 + 20 + 65 + this.yAxis.node().getBBox().x;
            this.yTitle.attr("dy", newYTitleX);
        };

        this.drawLine = function(delay){
            // Add line
            var lineMethod = d3.svg.line()
                                   .x(function(d,i){return f.xScale(i+1);})
                                   .y(function(d){return f.yScale(d);});

            for (var s in this.series){
                var sn = this.series[s];
                // Remove lines which not shown
                if (sn in this.lineObj && this.drawLine[sn] == false) {
                    this.lineObj[sn].transition().duration(100).remove();
                    delete this.lineObj[sn];
                    continue;
                }else if (!( sn in this.lineObj) && this.drawLine[sn] == true){
                    var avgValue = d3.mean(this.dataObj[sn]);
                    var tmpArr = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < this.datasetLen; i++) {
                        tmpArr.push(avgValue);
                    };
                    // Create a new line
                    var lineGroup = this.svg.append('g').attr('id', 'series_' + sn).style('pointer-events', 'none');
                    var linePath = lineGroup.append('path')
                                            .data(tmpArr)
                                            .attr("d", lineMethod(tmpArr))
                                            .attr('id', 'line_' + sn)
                                            .attr('stroke-linecap', 'round')
                                            .attr('stroke-linejoin', 'round')
                                            .style("fill", "none")
                                            .style("stroke-width", 1.5)
                                            .style('stroke', opt.colorSet[s]);

                    if (opt.drawdots == true) {
                        var dots = lineGroup.selectAll('circle')
                                             .data(tmpArr)
                                             .enter()
                                             .append('circle')
                                             .attr('cx', function (d, i){
                                                return f.xScale(i+1);
                                             })
                                             .attr('cy', function (d){
                                                return f.yScale(d);
                                             })
                                             .attr('r', opt.dotR)
											 .style('stroke',  opt.colorSet[s])
											 .style("stroke-width", 2)
                                             .attr('fill', 'white');
                    };
                    this.lineObj[sn] = lineGroup;
                }else if(!( sn in this.lineObj) && this.drawLine[sn] == false){
                    // stay not shown
                    continue;
                };
                this.lineObj[sn].transition().duration(delay*2).style('opacity', 1);
                this.lineObj[sn].select('path')
                           .data(this.dataObj[sn])
                           .transition()
                           .duration(delay)
                           .attr("d", lineMethod(this.dataObj[sn]));

                if (opt.drawdots == true) {
                    this.lineObj[sn].selectAll('circle')
                        .data(this.dataObj[sn])
                        .transition()
                        .duration(delay)
                        .attr('cx', function (d, i){
                            return f.xScale(i+1);
                        })
                        .attr('cy', function (d){
                            return f.yScale(d);
                        });
                };
            }

            // Add highlight dots
            if (this.highlightDots != null) {
                this.highlightDots.remove();
            };
            var tmpCol = [];
            for (var i in this.series){
                if (this.drawLine[this.series[i]] == true) {
                    tmpCol.push(opt.colorSet[i]);
                };
            };
            this.highlightDots = this.svg.append('g').attr('class', 'highlightDots').style('pointer-events', 'none');
            this.highlightDots.selectAll('circle')
                              .data(zipIdx(this.dataObj, 0, this.drawLine))
                              .enter()
                              .append('circle')
                              .attr('cx', 0)
                              .attr('cy', 0)
                              .attr('r', opt.dotR+1.5)
                              .attr('fill', function (d, i){
                                  return tmpCol[i];
                              })
                              .style('opacity', 0);

            // Update series
            this.currentSeries = [];
            for (var s in this.series){
                if (this.drawLine[this.series[s]] == true){
                    this.currentSeries.push(this.series[s]);
                };
            };
        };

        this.drawArea = function(delay){
            // Area method
            var areaMethod = d3.svg.area()
                               .x(function(d,i){return f.xScale(i+1);})
                               .y0(function(d){return f.yScale(d.top);})
                               .y1(function(d){return f.yScale(d.bot);});
            // first time Area Method
            var firstTimeAreaMethod = d3.svg.area()
                                        .x(function(d,i){return f.xScale(i+1);})
                                        .y0(function(d){return f.yScale(d.mid);})
                                        .y1(function(d){return f.yScale(d.mid);});
            var topMask = deepCopy(this.drawLine); // all draw is true
            var botMask = deepCopy(this.drawLine); // first draw is false
            for (var s in this.series){
                if (this.drawLine[this.series[s]] == true){
                    botMask[this.series[s]] = false;
                    break;
                };
            };

            this.currentDataObj = {};
            for (var s in this.series){
                if (this.drawLine[this.series[s]] == true) {
                    this.currentDataObj[this.series[s]] = [];
                    for (var i = 0; i < this.datasetLen; i++) {
                        var total = d3.sum(zipIdx(this.dataObj, i, this.drawLine));
                        var topVal = d3.sum(zipIdx(this.dataObj, i, topMask));
                        var botVal = d3.sum(zipIdx(this.dataObj, i, botMask));
                        this.currentDataObj[this.series[s]][i] = {'top': Math.round(10000*topVal/total)/100, 'bot': Math.round(10000*botVal/total)/100, 'mid': Math.round(10000*(topVal + botVal)/2/total)/100};
                    };
                    topMask[this.series[s]] = false;
                    for (var s in this.series){
                        if (this.drawLine[this.series[s]] == true && botMask[this.series[s]] == true){
                            botMask[this.series[s]] = false;
                            break;
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
            for (var s in this.series){
                var sn = this.series[s];
                // Remove lines which not shown
                if (sn in this.lineObj && this.drawLine[sn] == false) {
                    this.lineObj[sn].transition().duration(100).remove();
                    delete this.lineObj[sn];
                    continue;
                }else if (!( sn in this.lineObj) && this.drawLine[sn] == true){
                    // Create a new line
                    var lineGroup = this.svg.append('g').attr('id', 'series_' + sn);
                    var linePath = lineGroup.append('path')
                                            .data(this.currentDataObj[sn])
                                            .attr("d", firstTimeAreaMethod(this.currentDataObj[sn]))
                                            .attr('id', 'area_' + sn)
                                            .attr('stroke-linecap', 'round')
                                            .attr('stroke-linejoin', 'round')
                                            .style("fill", opt.colorSet[s])
                                            .style('stroke', 'none')
                                            .style('opacity', 0.5)
                                            .on('mouseover', function(){
                                                d3.select(this).style('opacity', 0.8);
                                                f.tipLine.style('opacity', 1);
                                                f.tipDiv.style('display', 'block');
                                            })
                                            .on('mouseout', function(){
                                                d3.select(this).style('opacity', 0.5);
                                                f.tipLine.style('opacity', 0);
                                                f.tipDiv.style('display', 'none');
                                                if (f.highlightDots != null) {
                                                    f.highlightDots.selectAll('circle').style('opacity', 0);
                                                };
                                            })
                                            .on('mousemove', function(){
                                                f.showTip();
                                            });

                    if (opt.drawdots == true) {
                        var dots = lineGroup.selectAll('circle')
                                             .data(tmpArr)
                                             .enter()
                                             .append('circle')
                                             .attr('cx', function (d, i){
                                                return f.xScale(i+1);
                                             })
                                             .attr('cy', function (d){
                                                return f.yScale(d);
                                             })
                                             .attr('r', opt.dotR)
                                             .attr('fill', opt.colorSet[s]);
                    };
                    this.lineObj[sn] = lineGroup;
                }else if(!( sn in this.lineObj) && this.drawLine[sn] == false){
                    // stay not shown
                    continue;
                };
                this.lineObj[sn].transition().duration(delay*2).style('opacity', 1);
                this.lineObj[sn].select('path')
                           .data(this.currentDataObj[sn])
                           .transition()
                           .duration(delay)
                           .attr("d", areaMethod(this.currentDataObj[sn]));

                if (opt.drawdots == true) {
                    this.lineObj[sn].selectAll('circle')
                        .data(this.dataObj[sn])
                        .transition()
                        .duration(delay)
                        .attr('cx', function (d, i){
                            return f.xScale(i+1);
                        })
                        .attr('cy', function (d){
                            return f.yScale(d);
                        });
                };
            };

            // Update series
            this.currentSeries = [];
            for (var s in this.series){
                if (this.drawLine[this.series[s]] == true){
                    this.currentSeries.push(this.series[s]);
                };
            };
        };

        this.showTip = function(){
            // console.log(f.tipSelector.node());
            var mousePos = d3.mouse(f.tipSelector.node());
            var mouseX = mousePos[0];
            var mouseY = mousePos[1];
            var xVal = d3.round(f.xScale.invert(mouseX));
            if (xVal == 0) {return};
            if (f.currentSeries.length == 0) {
                f.tipLine.style('opacity', 0);
                f.tipDiv.style('display', 'none');
                return;
            };
            f.tipHead.text(xVal);
            var rows = f.tipBody.selectAll('tr')
                              .data(f.currentSeries);
            rows.enter().append('tr');
            rows.exit().remove();

            var cells = rows.selectAll('td')
                            .data(function (row){
                                var v = f.tipValFunc(row, xVal - 1);
                                return [row, v];
                            });
            cells.exit().remove();
            cells.enter().append('td')
                         .text(function (d){return d})
                         .style('color', function (d){
                            var idx = f.series.indexOf(d);
                            if (idx >= 0) {
                                return f.opt.colorSet[idx];
                            }else {
                                return '#000';
                            };
                         });
            cells.text(function (d){return d})
                 .style('color', function (d){
                    var idx = f.series.indexOf(d);
                    if (idx >= 0) {
                        return f.opt.colorSet[idx];
                    }else {
                        return '#000';
                    };
                 });

            // Move tip line
            f.tipLine.attr('x1', f.xScale(xVal))
                   .attr('x2', f.xScale(xVal));

            if (opt.type == "line") {
                // Move circles
                var tmpData = zipIdx(f.dataObj, xVal -1, f.drawLine);
                f.highlightDots.selectAll('circle').data(tmpData)
                               .attr('cx', function (d){
                                   return f.xScale(xVal);
                               })
                               .attr('cy', function (d){
                                   return f.yScale(d);
                               }).style('opacity', 1);
            };

            // change position
            var space = 40;
            var tipWidth = parseInt(f.tipDiv.style('width'), 10);
            var tipHeight = parseInt(f.tipDiv.style('height'), 10);
            var bd = d3.select('body').node();
            var mouseBodyX = d3.mouse(bd)[0];
            var mouseBodyY = d3.mouse(bd)[1];
            var tipX = mouseBodyX + space;
            if (tipWidth + space + mouseX > f.xAxisLen) {
                tipX = mouseBodyX - space - tipWidth;
            };
            if (tipHeight + mouseY > f.yAxisLen) {
                mouseBodyY -= tipHeight + mouseY - f.yAxisLen - space;
            };
            f.tipDiv.style('left', tipX + 'px').style('top', mouseBodyY + 'px');
        };

        // run
        this.init();
    };

    function addSection (id, content) {

        for (var i in content.data) {

        var headDiv = section.append("div").attr('id', content.name);

    // QC function
    function applyQcCutoff (table, qcMetric) {
        // var qcColor = {"Normal": "#9DF894", "Warn": "#FFFF9B", "Fail": "#FF9B9B"};
        var qcColor = {"Normal": "#CFE593", "Warn": "#FFFF8C", "Fail": "#FF9494"};
        var trList = table.selectAll("tr").filter(function (d, i){ return d[0] in qcMetric;});
        for (var i = 0; i < trList[0].length; i++) {
            var tdList = d3.select(trList[0][i]).selectAll("td");
            // td List with two element, metric and value
            var elemData = tdList.data();
            var cutoff = qcMetric[elemData[0]];
            var value = elemData[1];
            // cutoff will be an array like [">90", ">80"]
            // the first value is cutoff of Normal (Green)
            // the second value is cutoff of Warn (Yellow)
            // if given value is lower/higher than Warn, mark as Fail (Red)
            var result = "None";
			var flag = 0;
			if (cutoff.length == 2)
				flag = 1;
            for (var c in cutoff) {
                // Get symbol: ">" or "<"
                var method = cutoff[c].substr(0, 1);
                // Convert string to number
                var cutVal = Number(cutoff[c].substr(1));
                if (compare(method, value, cutVal)) {
                    if (c == 0) {
						result = "Fail";
						if (flag == 1)	
							result = "Normal";					
                        break;
                    }else if (c == 1){
                        result = "Warn";
						if (flag == 1)					
							result = "Warn";
						break;
                    }else if (c == 2){
                        result = "Normal";
						break;
                    }else if (c == 3){
                        result = "Warn";
						break;
                    };
                }else{
				    result = "Fail";
                };
            };
            if (result != "None") {
                d3.select(tdList[0][1]).style("background", qcColor[result]);
            };
			flag = 0;
        };
    };
